Package nl.pim16aap2.lightkeeper.protocol

Class ProtocolPreconditions

java.lang.Object
nl.pim16aap2.lightkeeper.protocol.ProtocolPreconditions
public final class ProtocolPreconditions extends Object
Validation helpers for protocol command compact constructors.

Wire requests are deserialized straight into records, bypassing NullAway, so a malformed request can put null/garbage into a non-@Nullable field. Validating in the compact constructor rejects such input up front with a consistent IllegalArgumentException (which the dispatcher maps to INVALID_ARGUMENT) instead of letting it fail deep inside a server handler with an opaque error.

Example: 


 public Command
 {
     ProtocolPreconditions.requireNonBlank(requestId, "requestId");
     ProtocolPreconditions.requireNonNull(uuid, "uuid");
 }
